**PotentialWax 1.6.0**

- **FLIP the selected pad**, on the WAVE page: **REVERSE** plays it backwards, **HALF SPEED** plays it at half speed, an octave down, like a record at the wrong speed, and **FILTER** puts a low-pass on it. Mix them as you like; each pad keeps its own, your project remembers them, and SAVE KIT and SAVE PADS save the pads flipped. A new song starts with every pad unflipped.
- **BEAT CHOP** (CUES panel): the 16 pads one beat apart on the song's beat grid, 4 bars from the bar of the last pad you played. Tap it again without playing a pad to move on 4 bars.
- **KEY LOCK** (MATCH panel): one key for everything you dig. Switching it on with KEY on Original takes the key of the song you're on; every song you load then plays in that key, and ROLL leaves the key alone.
- Fixed: with the pitch shifter in use (KEY, PITCH or MATCH MPC with Keep Tempo), a pad stopped about 46 ms before its end. It now plays right up to the next cue.
- Five parameters were added at the end of the list; saved projects open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialWax-1.6.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialWax-1.6.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialWax-1.6.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialWax-1.6.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwax/issues/new/choose).
